scope.population: 2,480,267 taker fills of the 2,480,267 in quickwin_markouts.npz
scope.window: the span of quickwin_markouts.npz; the check reads the slice whole and does not cut it by date
scope.coins: every coin present in quickwin_markouts.npz; the agreement of direction with the pre-trade position is not cut by coin

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

checks.name: dir_code_implies_is_open
checks.assumption: is_open == 1 iff dir_code in {0=Open Long,1=Open Short}
checks.note: is_open is a deterministic function of dir_code; any mismatch means the two were not read from the same leg

checks.name: dir_x_startpos_crosstab
checks.assumption: start_pos sign convention: + = long, - = short (pre-trade inventory)
checks.method: cross-tabulate dir_code against sign(start_pos) with a near-zero bucket |start_pos| < 1e-09; report fractions over finite rows
checks.note: descriptive cross-tab; the directional expectation is evaluated in the close_fills_reduce_inventory check

checks.name: close_fills_reduce_inventory
checks.assumption: Close Long => start_pos > 0 (was long); Close Short => start_pos < 0 (was short). A pass means BOTH the dir map and the start_pos sign are read consistently.
checks.method: among dir_code==Close Long rows, fraction with start_pos>0; among dir_code==Close Short rows, fraction with start_pos<0; each expected cell must exceed 0.7
checks.note: the decisive field-semantics ground-truth: two independent JSON keys read from the same upstream fill object (dir string, startPosition number) must agree on the close direction; blind to a common-mode upstream error (closedPnl is a third-key corroborant)

checks.name: opens_diagnostic
checks.assumption: Open-from-flat => start_pos ~ 0; extensions of an existing position legitimately make opens nonzero same-sign
checks.method: report near-zero / same-sign / opposite-sign fractions for opens
checks.note: informational only; opens mix flat-opens and extensions so no clean directional expectation, NOT used in overall_verdict
